description: This file defines extension methods for configuring dependency injection services within an ASP.NET Core application, including registration of MediatR, validators, AutoMapper, security services, JWT authentication, and Serilog logging configuration.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for setting up dependency injection and security configurations in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Registers core application services such as MediatR, validators, AutoMapper, and security-related services into the dependency injection container.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT-based authentication, including token validation parameters, issuer, audience, and event handling.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog as the logging provider with console sink and enrichers, attaching it to the provided ILoggerFactory.
